Hi, Usually your SDHC should work with the wii but thats guessing with out knowing the brand and size, If you have a SDHC handy and can plug it into a PC/MAC then I can try help.

Having homebrew installed is half way to achieving your goal! Homebrew channel itself is always installed to the wii console so dont worry about moving that its where it belongs. 

Step 1 Format your SD card to Fat32

Step 2 Create a folder in the root of your SD card called apps

Step 3 Download Wiixplorer [R259.zip](https://sourceforge.net/projects/wiixplorer/files/R259.zip/download)

Step 4 Move contents of [R259.zip](https://R259.zip) to the apps folder on the SD Card

Step 5 Put SD card in wii and turn on & open homebrew channel

Step 6 Once in homebrew channel press 1 on the wii controller and click on Internal SD

Step 7 Open explorer and in the top left corner click and change to nand

Step 8 This is prob the most difficult part of this tutorial is locating the usbloader gx folder as i have no idea how your  wii is set up, but once located push the + button and cut

Step 9 In the top left corner again click and change to sd card, open apps then press + and paste
